stories.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
stories.explanation: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to guarantee billions in debt financing for Nscale's planned Anthropic data center in West Virginia. This arrangement would help Nscale secure funding for the project's electricity and construction costs.

stories.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
stories.explanation: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic plan to adopt a new standard allowing websites to opt out of AI scraping across multiple companies. This shared 'policy token' signal will enable publishers to apply their AI training preferences universally.

stories.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
stories.explanation: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to allow website operators to communicate their AI training preferences to multiple participating providers, simplifying content control for publishers.

stories.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
stories.explanation: Investor nervousness is growing regarding AI infrastructure spending, despite Big Tech's plans to invest billions. Concerns about negative free cash flow and mounting debt are raising questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom.

stories.title: Build a Validated Kubernetes Runtime for NVIDIA Dynamo
stories.explanation: NVIDIA has released AI Cluster Runtime (AICR) which packages NVIDIA Dynamo and its supporting infrastructure into validated recipes for easier management of infrastructure dependencies when building AI applications.

stories.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
stories.explanation: Microsoft is evaluating its Copilot AI at enterprise scale using synthetic data to address the challenges of sensitive real enterprise information, ensuring high performance through continuous testing.

stories.title: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain
stories.explanation: A biotech startup successfully used an AI agent with a robotic arm to perform a brain injection procedure on a live mouse. This demonstrates AI agents gaining direct access to lab equipment for research.

stories.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
stories.explanation: Apple will launch Apple Intelligence features in China with an iOS 27.3 beta next week, with a full release scheduled for December. This marks the introduction of Apple's AI capabilities to the Chinese market.

stories.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
stories.explanation: Anthropic is expected to receive a high 'junk' rating from credit agencies following its IPO, according to a report from the Financial Times. This could make it more difficult and costly for Anthropic to raise funds.

stories.title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
stories.explanation: An official Anthropic VS Code extension on Cursor was backdoored, potentially affecting up to 5,000 developers' machines. The attackers gained access to Anthropic's verified Cursor account to distribute the malicious version.
